desc: Read N and the sorted list A from standard input.
Implement a feasibility function `can_make(K)` that checks whether `2 * A[i] <= A[N - K + i]` for all `i = 0..K-1`.
Binary search the maximum K in the range `[0, N//2]` using the feasibility function.
Print the maximum feasible K to standard output.
Verify the implementation against the provided sample cases.
